A.description: Tested source of continuous integrity and high technical verifiability

B.description: Source with proven history and occasional unverified assertions

C.description: Source has demonstrated authentic output in some past instances

D.description: Source has past history of inaccuracies or bias

F.description: Inadequate basis or unverified novel source

1.description: Corroborated independently by non-correlated secondary and primary channels
